\chapter{Traps for people arriving from C\#}
\label{app:traps}

\chapterstub{%
The catalogue of habits that compile in the reader's head and fail in
Python, each elicited before it is named: a mutable default argument, a
late-binding closure, \code{is} against \code{==}, truthiness,
\code{\_\_eq\_\_} without \code{\_\_hash\_\_}, side effects at import,
integer caching under \code{is}, string building in a loop, a bare
\code{except}, a shadowed builtin, \code{[[]] * n} aliasing, floating-point
equality, \code{/} against \code{//}, and the rest of notes/02-traps.md.
Every entry names the chapter that owns it, and an entry no chapter owns is
a defect in the catalogue rather than a fact about the book.
}
